# Test vectors

These fixtures are **generated by the backend repository**
(`Calculator logistica`) via `scripts/export_permission_matrix.py` and
`scripts/export_invoice_test_vectors.py`. They are committed here as
read-only inputs for Phase 1+ / Phase 3 tests (blueprint §13.3 / §13.4).

**Do not edit by hand.** Regenerate them in the backend repo and copy the
updated files into this directory.
